name: Nourlangie Rock
objection: Could be treated as part of the Burrungkuy area with Nawurlandja and Anbangbang; but it is the headline site and the others are separate trailheads.

name: Nanguluwur Art Site
objection: Zero page views and a long dirt road; a second-tier rock art site that few visit. Wikivoyage still singles it out.

name: Twin Falls
objection: Seasonal and 4WD access; still a permanent place visitors reach on tours.

name: Gunlom
objection: Far south, 200 km from Jabiru; distance is not a reason to reject.

name: Bowali Visitor Centre
objection: A visitor centre can be a short stop; the walk-through display and gallery make it 30+ min.

name: Warradjan Aboriginal Cultural Centre
objection: A centre is a building and visits may be short; but exhibits and art make a 30+ min stop.

name: Mamukala Wetlands
objection: Seasonal (best late dry season); permanent venue, so allowed.

name: Nawurlandja Lookout
objection: Rule 3: a lookout on a track next to a listed spot is part of it; but Parks gives it its own walk entry.

name: Cahills Crossing
objection: Roadside stop of 15-30 min; but a guide singles it out, so it passes the roadside rule.

name: Mirrai Lookout
objection: Distinct from Mirray Lookout (near Ubirr); a mid-tier walk with zero page views.

name: Bardedjilidji Walk
objection: Close to Cahills Crossing and Ubirr; but its own walk and sandstone formations.

name: Manngarre Rainforest Walk
objection: Counted sources are Parks itineraries only; could be seen as a boat ramp stroll.

name: Gubara Pools
objection: Single counted source; but a clear description of a full activity.

name: Barrk Sandstone Walk
objection: Overlaps Nourlangie lookout track at the start; the long walk is a distinct activity.

name: Yurmikmik Walks
objection: A grouping of walks rather than a place; could be merged with Motor Car Falls.

name: Kungarre Walk
objection: Zero views; second-tier walk. Itinerary inclusion supports it.

name: Home Billabong
objection: Close to Yellow Water, and may be seen as part of that area; its separate walk and platform make it distinct.

name: Bukbukluk Lookout
objection: Name only in a navigation menu; cannot confirm the visit length or access.

name: Marrawuddi Arts & Culture
objection: Close to being a shop (rule 2).

name: Injalak Hill
objection: The tour is the way in; per the vehicle/operator rule the place is the spot, but it is not freely accessible.

name: Roy Marika Lookout
objection: A lookout over a town; ten-minute look.

name: Gayngaru Wetlands
objection: Could be a local reserve rather than a tourist stop; tourism board does list it.

name: Wirrwawuy
objection: Near-duplicate of the nearby beach stretch (Middle Beach, Galuru) and a single source.

name: Galuru (East Woody Beach)
objection: Overlap with Dhamitjinya, its walk-out point; the beach is the access and a distinct place.

name: Dhamitjinya (East Woody Island)
objection: Tidal access and shares a beach with Galuru; but a distinct walk-out destination.

name: Gadalathami (Town Beach)
objection: A town beach locals use.

name: Garanhan (Macassan Beach)
objection: Single source and camping needs a permit; the day visit is open.

name: Banambarrna (Rainbow Cliffs)
objection: Single source; a roadside-ish stop of half an hour.

name: Bremer Island
objection: Single source; needs boat or air and resort access; day cruises exist.

name: Victoria Settlement
objection: Heritage ruins with a difficult access.

name: Black Point Cultural Centre
objection: Staffed? Not confirmed; remote.

name: Umbakumba Art Centre
objection: A single-line listing.

name: Groote Eylandt
objection: Remote island of about 1,500 km2; access by SeaLink-run flight and permit.

name: Maningrida
objection: Town as wrapper of its attraction; the earlier script found no counted source.
